title: Organelle associations and metabolic rewiring of size-defined hepatic lipid droplets
task: Map size-dependent lipid droplet organelle associations and metabolic fate programming
key_results: Large LDs associate with mitochondria for oxidative metabolism; small LDs associate with lysosomes for degradation and turnover. Fasting/steatosis remodels these associations, recruiting lysosomal machinery to small LDs and mitochondria to both pools.
comments: The 'parallel programs' model elegantly explains how LD size orchestrates distinct metabolic outcomes, though causal roles of organelle recruitment in driving fate decisions require functional validation.

model_io.model: Hepatic lipid droplet fractionation and proteomics

hypotheses.hypothesis: LD size determines organelle partnership and metabolic fate
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: large LDs couple to mitochondria for fuel oxidation; small LDs couple to lysosomes for turnover

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metabolic stress plastically remodels LD-organelle associations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: fasting/steatosis inducibly recruit lysosomal machinery to small LDs and mitochondria to both pools

hypotheses.hypothesis: Small-LD lysosomal axis is a regulatory node in MAFLD
hypotheses.result: Supported by association patterns but direct causal evidence not provided

title: Multi-task deep learning framework for brain tumor classification and segmentation using ensemble feature extraction
task: Brain tumor classification and segmentation from MRI
comments: Multi-task framework reduces computational burden but lacks independent validation on external datasets and comparison with state-of-the-art methods.

model_io.model: Ensemble feature extraction (ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B5, CNN + attention modules) + U-Net++

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combined classification-segmentation in one framework reduces computational burden versus sequential approaches
hypotheses.result: Achieved 99.84% classification and 91.22% Dice coefficient on public MRI dataset

title: Multivariate computational strategies for mechanisms involving gut microbiome metabolite targets of Astragalus in diabetic sarcopenic obesity
task: Elucidate multi-target mechanisms of Astragalus in diabetic sarcopenic obesity via drug-disease-microbiota networks
key_results: Kaempferol and jaranol identified as core ingredients targeting AKT1, ESR1, MMP9, APP, IGF1R; linked to insulin resistance, AMPK/HIF-1/TNF pathways
comments: Computational prediction-heavy approach; requires experimental validation of herb-ingredient bioavailability and in vivo target engagement in diabetic sarcopenia.

model_io.model: Network pharmacology (CytoNCA, GMFA, STRING, molecular docking/dynamics)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Astragalus alleviates diabetic sarcopenic obesity through kaempferol/jaranol targeting insulin resistance and metabolic pathways
hypotheses.result: Identified 11 core genes in AMPK, HIF-1, TNF, and insulin signaling pathways with predicted docking to AKT1, ESR1, MMP9, APP, IGF1R

title: Integrating bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing to identify mitochondrial quality control-related key genes in rheumatoid arthritis
task: Identify mitochondrial quality control genes in rheumatoid arthritis via integrated bulk and scRNA-seq
key_results: CDC42 and RBBP7 identified as key MQC genes; CDC42 upregulated, RBBP7 downregulated in RA; monocytes positively correlated with CDC42, negatively with RBBP7
comments: Comprehensive multi-omics integration with functional validation, but findings limited to blood-derived samples; causality not established.

model_io.model: Weighted gene co-expression network + machine learning + single-cell analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: MQC dysfunction through CDC42 and RBBP7 dysregulation links to JAK-STAT signaling and monocyte activation in RA
hypotheses.result: CDC42 upregulation associated with monocyte infiltration; RBBP7 downregulation in B cells; GSEA linked CDC42 to JAK-STAT pathway

title: A hybrid quantum algorithm for multi-resolution arrhythmia classification
task: ECG arrhythmia classification at variable image resolutions using hybrid quantum-classical circuits
key_results: Hybrid quantum algorithm achieved 0.9690 ± 0.0124 mean accuracy at 112 pixels vs. 0.9396 ± 0.0044 for ResNet50; no consistent advantage across resolutions and random initializations
comments: Lack of patient-independent and external validation limits generalizability; quantum advantage appears marginal and initialization-dependent.

model_io.model: Hybrid quantum algorithm (ResNet50 backbone + 10-qubit variational quantum circuit)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid quantum circuit provides classification advantage under spatial-information reduction
hypotheses.result: Highest mean accuracy at 112 pixels but variable performance across seeds; quantum advantage not consistent

title: A novel, synergy-based kinematic model of the foot and ankle for gait analysis
task: Reconstruct foot-ankle bone kinematics using motion synergies
key_results: In-vitro errors <7° rotation and 4 mm translation; distinguished healthy vs. flat vs. diabetic feet with transverse arch deformation assessment
comments: Clever exploitation of kinematic synergies from CT imaging reduces model complexity to 5 DOF with minimal markers, though clinical validation remains preliminary.

model_io.model: Synergy-based multibody kinematic optimization (SB-MKO) with PCA-derived motion couplings

hypotheses.hypothesis: Motion synergies derived from CT scans enable low-complexity foot model matching standard multi-segment accuracy
hypotheses.result: SB-MKO achieved average errors below 7° and 4 mm using only 4 foot markers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synergy-based model enables transverse arch assessment unavailable in conventional models
hypotheses.result: Superior discrimination between populations and quantification of arch deformation

title: Adaptive entropy-guided access point selection for robust multi-floor Wi-Fi fingerprinting
task: Entropy-guided AP selection for multi-floor Wi-Fi indoor localization
key_results: Dimensionality reduction: 90.11% (F3, 17 APs, -0.41% accuracy), 95.34% (F4, 8 APs, -0.51%), 84.88% (F5, 26 APs, -0.42%); improved robustness to noise on F5 at 1–3 dB
comments: Lightweight entropy-based framework with thorough robustness evaluation, but trade-offs emerge under strong perturbations; floor-dependent sensitivity suggests limited generalizability across diverse environments.

model_io.model: Random Forest classifier with Shannon entropy AP ranking
inputs: RSSI measurements from 172 APs across 3 floors, 4 devices, multiple contexts (JUIndoorLoc dataset)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Entropy-based AP selection reduces dimensionality while preserving localization accuracy and improving noise robustness
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; substantial reduction achieved with minimal accuracy loss, but floor-dependent trade-offs under strong noise perturbations limit robustness consistency

title: An improved YOLOv8 framework fused with attention mechanism and gold-YOLO neck for abnormal driving behavior detection in automobiles
task: Abnormal driving behavior detection via improved YOLOv8 with attention and GD-neck
key_results: Gold-YOLOv8 precision 94.387% (+0.891pp), F1 0.9449 (+0.0045), mAP@0.5 0.97598 (+0.00253) vs baseline YOLO-v8n
comments: Modest incremental gains from Gather-Distribute mechanism; real-time capability claimed but inference latency and model size not explicitly stated.

outputs: abnormal driving behavior detections (eye closure, yawning, head turning, phone use)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gather-Distribute multi-scale fusion improves detection of fine-grained driver anomalies
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; precision, F1, and mAP all improved; suitable for real-time edge deployment

title: An innovative framework for student adaptability prediction using discriminant-based classification, feature selection, and sensitivity analysis
task: Student adaptability classification with metaheuristic optimization
key_results: QDA + GAO optimization achieves 97.5% accuracy; outperforms XGBoost and LDA variants
comments: High accuracy on single dataset (n=1205) but lacks external validation; sensitivity analysis (FAST) results not quantified in abstract.

model_io.model: QDA optimized by Giant Armadillo Optimization (GAO)
inputs: demographic, educational, socio-economic attributes (1205 student records)

hypotheses.hypothesis: GAO optimization improves QDA classification accuracy over baseline and other algorithms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; QDA+GAO achieves 0.975 vs other configurations

title: Resilience assessment and prediction of fresh agricultural product supply chains using variable fuzzy recognition and machine learning
task: Resilience assessment and prediction for fresh agricultural product supply chains
key_results: CNN outperforms Decision Tree, Random Forest, Linear Regression; captures temporal dynamics and nonlinear patterns; robust under limited/noisy data
comments: Hybrid approach (variable fuzzy + CNN) is well-motivated but CNN performance metrics (accuracy, RMSE) not quantified in abstract; generalizability beyond China's 31 provinces untested.

model_io.model: Variable Fuzzy Set model + AHP/CRITIC weighting
inputs: production, transportation, consumption indicators (panel data, 31 provinces, 2009–2023)

model_io.model: Baselines: Decision Tree, Random Forest, Linear Regression

hypotheses.hypothesis: CNN captures temporal dynamics and nonlinear patterns better than classical methods in resilience prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CNN outperforms baselines particularly on nonlinear patterns and high-resilience cases

title: Optimization of conductivity for MXene polymer nanocomposites by the number and diameter of contacts among adjacent nanosheets
task: Optimization of MXene nanocomposite conductivity via contact geometry
key_results: Max conductivity 6.2 S/m achieved at 40 contacts with 50 nm diameter; percolation and tunneling effects integrated into single model
comments: Physics-based model with parametric validation is sound but lacks experimental confirmation on fabricated samples at predicted optimal parameters.

model_io.model: Conductivity prediction model (percolation + tunneling + contact geometry)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interphase thickness of 40 nm and 40 contacts at 50 nm diameter maximize conductivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through parametric analysis; 6.2 S/m achieved

title: An underwater object detection method based on generative degradation simulation and hard-sample learning
task: Underwater object detection with synthetic degradation simulation and hard-sample mining
key_results: mAP@0.5: 85.3% (URPC2020), 79.6% (DUO), 66.2% (UODD), 84.7% (Brackish); 6.7pp higher than baseline at high degradation
comments: Comprehensive evaluation across four datasets with ablation study; practical inference time (18.7ms) suitable for deployment but degradation simulation generalizability to out-of-domain waters unclear.

model_io.model: GDH-Det: Conditional diffusion network + YOLOv8 detector with paired-feature loss

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic degradation combined with hard-sample mining improves robustness at high degradation severity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; at degradation level 5, mAP@0.5 remains 74.8% vs 68.1% for AGW-YOLOv8

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-scale feature computation with degradation conditions preserves class information
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ablation shows 4.9pp improvement over baseline on real samples

title: Integrated architectures for IFC interoperability and legacy BIM migration with a deterministic IFC2X3 data-quality pilot
task: IFC data-quality assessment and interoperability framework for BIM legacy migration
key_results: 300 seeded IFC2X3 elements: LoadBearing properties 255/300, positive Length 200/300, material grades 210/300; manual-automated agreement 100% on implementation consistency
comments: Empirical pilot is limited to consistency validation rather than true accuracy assessment; AI/ML components for regulatory updating and blockchain provenance deferred to future work.

model_io.model: Automated IFC property extraction (R5 pathway for dimensions)
inputs: IFC2X3 steel model elements (300 samples from 3 models)
outputs: extracted properties (LoadBearing, Length, material grade, identifiers, relationships)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic automated extraction achieves 100% agreement with manual annotation on 300 seeded elements
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; manual-automated agreement exact for reconciled consensus baseline (consistency only, not validation)

title: Programmable high-dimensional state synthesis through a 20-m multimode fiber via long-coherence atomic photons
task: High-dimensional quantum state synthesis through multimode fiber
key_results: Process fidelities exceeding 92.5% for spatial-mode qudits up to d=7 dimension through 20-m fiber; overcomes modal dispersion limits via atomic photon coherence
comments: Leveraging atomic ensemble coherence is elegant, but scalability to even longer distances or higher dimensions remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ultra-long coherence of atomic photons overcomes modal dispersion in long multimode fibers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: achieved high fidelity over 20 m versus previous short-distance demonstrations

title: Enhanced X-ray shielding performance of HDPE–Sb₂O₃ composites in the diagnostic dental X-ray energy range
task: X-ray shielding performance of HDPE–Sb₂O₃ composites for diagnostic dental applications
key_results: 15 wt% Sb₂O₃ composite shows highest attenuation across 50–150 kVp; thermal stability improved (Td 464.8 °C vs. 446.3 °C for neat HDPE) with minimal tensile strength loss (23.91 vs. 24.97 MPa)
comments: Comprehensive experimental and computational validation, though the modest tensile strength reduction may limit some applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increasing Sb₂O₃ content enhances low-energy X-ray attenuation via higher effective atomic number and photoelectric probability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 15 wt% composite achieves best performance across all energy levels

title: Interfacial control and evaporation pinning of nanocapillary filling from ambient to serpentinization temperatures
task: Nanoscale capillary filling and evaporation dynamics in hydrophilic channels
key_results: Electrokinetic resistance and wall viscosity explain measured slowdown versus classical theory; evaporation-driven pinning predicted at ~200 °C in low-humidity regime
comments: The high-temperature evaporation pinning regime is novel and potentially impactful for geologic applications, but experimental validation is still pending.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electrokinetic resistance and elevated wall viscosity suppress nanoscale capillary filling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across independent experiments

hypotheses.hypothesis: Evaporation balances capillary inflow and pins meniscus at elevated temperature in low-humidity conditions
hypotheses.result: Predicted; awaits experimental testing

title: Bacteroides–Escherichia interactions contribute to colonization resistance against Clostridioides difficile
task: Identify microbial interactions and metabolic pathways conferring colonization resistance against C. difficile
key_results: Bacteroides–Escherichia ratio is a stronger predictor of C. difficile suppression than alpha diversity; fructooligosaccharides, vitamin B3 biosynthesis, and Stickland precursor competition identified as causal suppression mechanisms across multiple strains
comments: Integration of generalized Lotka-Volterra, genome-scale metabolic modeling, and experimental validation provides mechanistic insights, though synthetic community findings required validation in complex patient-derived microbiota.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Specific Bacteroides–Escherichia interactions suppress C. difficile through metabolic competition and metabolite production
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; fructooligosaccharides, vitamin B3, and Stickland precursor competition identified as causal mechanisms

hypotheses.hypothesis: Identified metabolic pathways are relevant in vivo across patient cohorts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; metagenomics analysis of clinical data attested relevance; Bacteroides–Escherichia ratio predictive of resistance
